column1: # Host rename map: Ios*/ios* names declared in hostMain (sharedCore, sharedLogic, sharedUi) -> host names.
# Format: old<TAB>new[<TAB># reason]. Longest old name first. Used by scripts/apply-host-rename.sh and
# HostRenameGuardTest. Rule: leading Ios -> Host (ios -> host), HostHost -> Host; on a clash pick Host<Role>.
# Entries marked "# file" name a hostMain file whose stem is not a declared type; they rename the file and textual mentions of it.
